chunks.text:
[Intro]
{stepping in from the cold: a soft music-box arpeggio rolls down like a door easing shut, one celesta glint, then the lead's first sighing notes settle into the theme}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the lullaby melody in A minor, rocking in 6/8 over the music-box; the hopeful rising lift undershoots and lingers, more sigh than leap; clear and hummable}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the same melody again, now with a soft flute counter-line woven under it and the strings a little warmer, like the fire catching again}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: the melody turns to warm C major and moves higher, a cosy memory of daytime, music-box and celesta brighter, then sways back down toward the minor}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the lullaby returns in A minor, fuller and calm; the last bar sways straight back into the theme, no ending}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick
seamless loop back to the start of the theme
